requirement: EnsemblID is the only immutable entity/join key and must match the frozen included target-manifest value byte-for-byte.
scientific_rationale: Prevents identity drift and symbol joins.
validation_method: Unique-key and exact-value comparison to target manifest.
frozen_provenance_basis: Task #022 universe schema and Task #021 contract

requirement: profile_id uses EnsemblID, profile_version, evidence_snapshot_version, input_manifest_sha256, and rules_sha256 in the canonical formula.
scientific_rationale: A profile changes identity when evidence or rules change.
frozen_provenance_basis: Task #021 deterministic identity refined for explicit evidence snapshot

requirement: release_id is content-derived from the complete frozen release configuration and cannot use randomness or wall time.
scientific_rationale: Makes the release reproducible and immutable.

requirement: Each EnsemblID has exactly one profile_id and exactly 11 unique component rows.
profile_version changes when schema, component semantics, or interpretation boundaries change.
scientific_rationale: Separates structural meaning from evidence updates.
validation_method: Compare version manifest to schema/rule hashes.

requirement: evidence_snapshot_version is content-derived from ordered evidence artifacts, source versions, and query scopes.
scientific_rationale: Prevents two evidence snapshots sharing an ambiguous label.
validation_method: Recompute snapshot version from evidence manifest.

requirement: Prior released bundles are immutable; changed inputs or rules create a new release_id.
Required fields are present, nonblank, and conform to controlled data types and sentinels.
Optional annotations cannot affect joins, state resolution, ordering, or release eligibility.
validation_method: Static code/dataflow check plus mutation test.

requirement: No prohibited field, alias, derived equivalent, or hidden aggregation may appear in profile data or sidecars.
Every claim_id resolves to the same EnsemblID and an allowed component evidence domain.
Every evidence_record_id resolves to a linked claim_id and source_entity_id.
Records may be deduplicated only by identical record_id; reuse across components retains the same ID.
scientific_rationale: Prevents unsupported merging or double creation.

requirement: Artifact IDs are explicitly paired with hashes and include every registry needed to reconstruct lineage.
dependency_edge_ids encode the exact induced graph among component evidence records.
scientific_rationale: Retains which record pair is dependent.
validation_method: Recompute induced graph from frozen dependency registry.

requirement: Each dependency ID maps to its exact endpoints, relationship, level, and review status in the frozen graph.
Absence of an edge cannot be emitted or interpreted as INDEPENDENT.
Every record has an explicit record_id=missingness mapping.
scientific_rationale: Preserves record-level meaning that set-like lists cannot encode.
validation_method: Reconstruct and compare to frozen record registry.

requirement: OBSERVED, PARTIAL, MISSING, NOT_QUERIED, and CONFLICTING remain distinct component states.
MISSING requires completed defined query scope with no qualifying record and no unknown/failure.
scientific_rationale: Separates absence after assessment from non-acquisition.
validation_method: Coverage manifest and rule predicate test.

requirement: NOT_QUERIED requires no eligible acquisition or valid assessment and cannot be inferred from zero/blank.
Conflicting records, IDs, and comparison rule are retained without choosing or averaging.
scientific_rationale: Preserves uncertainty and avoids hidden adjudication.

requirement: Generator ID, version, executable hash, rules version/hash, and serialization version are frozen before materialization.
validation_method: Run-manifest preflight and postflight hash checks.

requirement: Every linked source has an explicit version; UNKNOWN prevents provenance_complete=TRUE.
The release bundle includes or resolvably references the frozen target manifest, schema, rules, claims, records, sources, dependency graph, artifact manifest, QC, and session metadata.
All 55 component/state predicates have executable, reviewed, versioned implementations tied to the frozen Task #021 semantic predicates.
scientific_rationale: Controlled prose alone cannot guarantee deterministic execution.
validation_method: Unit/fixture tests and exact predicate-ID/hash mapping.

requirement: State precedence is CONFLICTING, OBSERVED, MISSING, PARTIAL, NOT_QUERIED and exactly one state resolves.
Identical frozen inputs, generator, rules, timestamp, and serialization produce byte-identical complete release bundles.
validation_method: Independent clean regeneration and SHA256 comparison.

requirement: Target order follows the frozen manifest; component order follows the frozen registry; list values are unique and canonically ordered.
Wall clock, locale, filesystem traversal, randomness, process ID, Symbol, or LLM output may influence profile bytes.
validation_method: Environment mutation tests and static code review.

requirement: Identity, lineage, dependency, missingness, provenance, interpretation-safety, and regeneration gates all pass before status=RELEASED.
scientific_rationale: No partial release of an invalid bundle.
validation_method: QC matrix completion and zero FAIL checks.

requirement: Input hashes are verified before and after generation and output hashes are frozen only after canonical serialization.
Component states or record counts may not be combined into a score, rank, priority, recommendation, overall state, or completeness percentage.
validation_method: Schema, code, and output derivation audit.

requirement: OBSERVED may not be labeled favorable and MISSING/NOT_QUERIED may not be labeled unfavorable or negative.
Profiles may not assert causality, efficacy, safety, clinical benefit, therapeutic direction, or target recommendation.
scientific_rationale: Separates evidence organization from decision interpretation.
